title: Change QMeshPolygonNode polygon radius in code
body:
I am trying to change the polygon radius in code for a softbody. Is seems that the function: set_polygon_radius(value) does not work. I tested it like this:
```
extends QSoftBodyNode

var expanded_size = 100
var normal_size= 40

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:            
	if Input.is_action_pressed("expand"):
		$Mesh.set_polygon_radius(expanded_size)  #$Mesh is a QMeshPolygonNode
	else:
		$Mesh.set_polygon_radius(normal_size)

```
This does not work too
```
extends QSoftBodyNode

var expanded_size = 100
var normal_size = 40

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:            
	if Input.is_action_pressed("expand"):
		$Mesh.polygon_radius = expanded_size
	else:
		$Mesh.polygon_radius = normal_size

```

I know the code isnt efficent, its just for demonstration
author: WilleIshere

comments.body:
Hi @WilleIshere. Objects like QMeshCircleNode, QMeshPolygonNode, and QMeshRectNode are nodes that generate the target mesh when added to the scene based on your settings. We do something similar with QMeshAdvancedNode using an editor plugin.

If a QMeshNode object is under a QSoftBodyNode, its particles move individually.  Therefore, if you want to control the particles during the simulation, you need to use methods related to the particles directly. In the example you provided, you would need to modify both the local,global positions of the particles and the spring properties that enforce distance constraints between them.
Thanks, Can you give an example how this can be done?

title: Editor crashes when changing value in QMesh nodes by click and drag in inspector
body:
**Describe the bug**
When you click and drag in some inspector properties for QMesh nodes (Grid in QMeshRect and Side Count for Polygon) to change the value the editor crashes. 


**To Reproduce**
Open 2_softbody_show example
Select QMeshRectNode
Click and hold in the Grid property and drag mouse to change value

**Expected behavior**
Change the value and not crash the editor

**Desktop (please complete the following information):**
 Godot v4.4.dev7

comments.body: Hi @Giganzo  Thanks for the share this problem. This issue will be solved in the next version.

title: Does it integrate directly with existing physics engine?
body:
Eg how jolt/rapier does? By replacing the physics server? If not are there plans to do so?

Thanks
author: Ughuuu

comments.body:
Hi @Ughuuu . The reason QuarkPhysics is not integrated into Godot's PhysicsServer is that PhysicsServer provides an API designed for a traditional velocity-based rigid body physics engine. Since QuarkPhysics is a position-based physics engine with different dynamics, adapting its API to Godot's PhysicsServer methods is technically not feasible.

Therefore, to fully utilize Godot's capabilities while maintaining complete control over QuarkPhysics' API within Godot, we prefer to keep them separate. A few more adjustments are needed to make the current integration feel more seamless, but these changes will generally not introduce breaking changes in the current version.
